versions.author: designer
versions.summary:
Units left untouched gain Age each turn, then turn it into stats, gold, damage and one-off Awakenings.
Bats and dormice move Age between units to tip thresholds, cash it in, or feed the oldest or youngest unit.

versions.author: reviser
versions.summary:
Rewrote Mother Ribica, Lamplighter Hrošč and Brother Netopir so a player can read them: Ribica repeats Awakens at fixed steps, Hrošč doubles stats and damage from Age.
Gilled Hatchling now says it pays per Age, and the Seven-Month Dormouse pays 1 gold a turn instead of half.

versions.author: reviser
versions.summary:
Lamplighter Hrošč now says Awaken effects aren't doubled and extra copies don't stack; Echo Bat says Age moves before the sale removes it.
Golden Echo Bat adds a flat 2 Age and golden Netopir copies only once a turn, so Age no longer compounds through sales.
